Shape: **Routine** — bounded prompt changes and synchronization fit one claim; verdict and gate support already exists.

**What we know:** The general planner structure conflicts with compact Routine guidance (`.swarm/prompts/planner.md:8–22`); reviewer output always requires a table (`.swarm/prompts/reviewer.md:12`). Direct diffs confirm repository planner lacks the template's split and PR revision sections, and reviewer lacks PR revision context. Templates are not currently matching copies. Runtime loads repository prompts (`internal/harness/scaffold.go:773`). `TestPlannerSplitRecommendationInstructions` covers template split guidance; existing lease tests cover verdict-only approvals and digest binding.

**What we're assuming:** explicit Routine precedence resolves the conflict; verify by contract assertions and reading the whole prompts. **Open questions:** none blocking; word count is guidance, not a runtime guarantee.

1. Make `internal/harness/templates/swarm/prompts/{planner,reviewer}.md` canonical: first bring `.swarm/prompts/{planner,reviewer}.md` up to their template content unchanged. Sync the split and PR revision sections verbatim, without rewriting them. This deliberately restores missing shared guidance; preserve all Involved, Exploratory and Urgent per-shape bullets byte-for-byte.
2. Apply identical Routine edits to each role's repository and template copies. Planner requires only confirmed cause/files, smallest change, acceptance-to-test mapping, and unresolved risks if any; retain both artifacts and a brief shape indication. Set a soft 150–250-word target expandable for correctness; explicitly waive general headings, alternatives, and restated objective/constraints. Reviewer changes only REVIEW.md output format for Routine: existing first-line verdict plus actionable findings, verdict alone for clean approval, no audit table or plan recap. Preserve contract checks 2–4 and other shapes' behavior.
3. Add `internal/harness/routine_prompt_test.go` with `TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync` and `TestRoutineReviewerPromptContractAndSync`: equality/scaffolding checks, compact contracts, preserved original bullets, unchanged synced sections, and explicit reviewer duty assertions detailed in TEST_PLAN.md. Add `changes/unreleased/197-compact-routine-contract.md`.
4. Run TEST_PLAN.md checks. Approval, digest, parser, gate and validation code and existing tests remain untouched. Developer records notes in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`; tester records results in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Planner: address review F1 (make the template canonical; bring repository planner.md and reviewer.md up to template content unchanged, then apply the Routine edits identically) and F2 (name the asserted strings showing the Routine reviewer exception only changes REVIEW.md output format). Developer: notes in IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: results in VALIDATION.md. Run targeted tests; at most one full suite.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->

# ISSUE-197 acceptance verification

| Acceptance | Cases and evidence | Command |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Compact Routine planner contract | New `TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync`: compare repository and embedded template (normalize CRLF), initialize a temporary repository and inspect scaffolded output. Assert confirmed cause/files, smallest change, acceptance mapping, optional risks, soft 150–250 words with correctness expansion, and explicit waivers of general headings, alternatives, objective/constraints restatement. Read the whole prompt to ensure unconditional instructions do not override the exception and both artifacts remain required. | `go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestRoutinePlannerPromptContractAndSync$'` |
| 2. Compact Routine review; other shapes preserved; copies synchronized | New `TestRoutineReviewerPromptContractAndSync`: same equality/scaffold checks; assert exact verdict choices, actionable findings only, verdict-only clean approval, no Routine audit table or recap, and retained review rigor. In both new tests cover the preserved Involved, Exploratory, and Urgent guidance; inspect the diff to confirm changes apply only to Routine and surrounding dispatch language. | `go test ./internal/harness -run '^TestRoutine(Planner\|Reviewer)PromptContractAndSync$'` |
| 3. Digests and human gates unchanged | Run existing approval authentication, input-binding, human-gate, and fail-closed parser tests without modifying them. Inspect the diff to confirm no authority or validation implementation changes and no edits to existing tests. | Commands below. |
| 4. make check passes | Run formatting, vet, staticcheck, and race-enabled suite via the existing target once at the end. Record outcomes and any environmental blockers; coordinator reruns all required checks. | `make check` |

Targeted regression commands:

```bash
go test ./internal/lease -run 'Test(ReviewApprovalRequiresAuthenticatedConsistentEvidence|AgentReviewCannotBeReboundAfterInputsChange|CurrentPlanHumanApprovalRequired)$'
go test ./internal/cli -run '^TestCLIHumanGateCannotBeBypassedByReviewOrSubmit$'
go test ./internal/workflow -run '^TestParseReviewVerdictFailsClosed$'
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Review the changelog fragment for a short description of Routine planning/review behavior. New prompt tests should fail against the original prompts. Prompt assertions verify the instructions, not a model's generated word count.

Follow operator limits: use targeted tests during development and at most one full-suite run at the end (`make check` supplies that run). The coordinator separately runs the approved fmt/build/vet/staticcheck/test checks; do not duplicate its full suite. Developer records notes in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`; tester records results in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`. This planning phase does not execute implementation checks.

<!-- swarm:guidance:start -->
## Operator guidance

> Developer: record notes in .swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md. Tester: record results in .swarm/active/VALIDATION.md. Both: the coordinator reruns every required check; run targeted tests (-run, single packages) and at most one full-suite run at the end.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->
